pelican bar.name: Pelican bar
say: A long bar in a low room, the floor still wet from the mop. Somebody has left the radio on.
Brass rails, green glass and one clean stool. The band next door thumps through the wall.
The bar is quiet for a Friday. Every bottle has been turned to face the door.

things.name: A long zinc bar
things.line: Wet rings on the zinc, a cloth left folded.
things.look: GM-ONLY-look: a till key taped under the lip, still warm.
things.roll: GM-ONLY-roll: 4/5 a few notes. 6: the whole float.

things.name: A row of upturned stools
things.line: Legs in the air, ready for the floor to be swept.
things.look: GM-ONLY-look: one stool is bolted down and rattles.
things.roll: GM-ONLY-roll: 4/5 a bolt, loose. 6: a stool leg that makes a club.

things.name: A mirror behind the bottles
things.line: It shows the door better than the door does.
things.look: GM-ONLY-look: a smear where someone wiped a name off the glass.

things.name: A glass-washer, humming
things.line: Warm steam leaks from the lid.
things.look: GM-ONLY-look: a wristwatch in the rinse tray.
things.roll: GM-ONLY-roll: 4/5 the watch is stopped. 6: it is engraved.

things.name: A service hatch
things.line: A square of dark at knee height, hinged.
things.look: GM-ONLY-look: it opens on the kitchen passage.

things.name: A waiter’s tray
things.line: Left on the bar with one clean glass.
things.look: GM-ONLY-look: a folded note under the glass, a table number.

things.name: A jar of cocktail sticks
things.line: Coloured, with little paper flags.
things.look: GM-ONLY-look: one flag is a tight scroll of paper.
things.roll: GM-ONLY-roll: 4/5 a time. 6: a time and a street.

things.name: A velvet rope on brass posts
things.line: It cuts the bar off from the dance floor.
things.look: GM-ONLY-look: one post is hollow and rings.
things.danger: GM-ONLY-danger: The posts fall like dominoes.

things.name: A radio on the shelf
things.line: A dance band, turned low.
things.look: GM-ONLY-look: it cuts out when anyone nears the till.

things.name: A barman’s apron on a hook
things.line: Stiff with old cordial.
things.look: GM-ONLY-look: the pocket holds a pencil and a rota.

pelican cloakroom.name: Pelican cloakroom
say: A narrow cloakroom that smells of rain and hair oil. Numbered tags clink on the rail.
Coats packed so close that the room muffles every word. A bell sits on the counter.
Cream walls and a single lamp. The attendant’s stool is empty and still warm.

things.name: A rail of coats
things.line: Numbered tags swing on every hanger.
things.look: GM-ONLY-look: one coat is far too heavy for its owner.
things.roll: GM-ONLY-roll: 4/5 a purse. 6: a purse and a key.

things.name: A brass bell on the counter
things.line: Dented, with a ribbon for the hammer.
things.look: GM-ONLY-look: the ribbon is cut, not frayed.
things.danger: GM-ONLY-danger: It rings the whole house.

things.name: A ticket book
things.line: Pink stubs, torn along the dotted line.
things.look: GM-ONLY-look: the last stub has two names on it.

things.name: A hat shelf
things.line: Fedoras and one feathered thing.
things.look: GM-ONLY-look: a hat is dry on a wet night.

things.name: A narrow side door
things.line: Painted the same cream as the wall.
things.look: GM-ONLY-look: it opens on the alley, and its bolt is oiled.

things.name: An umbrella stand
things.line: A dozen black umbrellas, one very long.
things.look: GM-ONLY-look: the long one is a blade in a sleeve.
things.roll: GM-ONLY-roll: 4/5 a blade, short. 6: a blade, and a lord’s crest.

things.name: A lost-property box
things.line: Gloves, a spectacle case, a child’s shoe.
things.look: GM-ONLY-look: a diary with the corner turned down.

things.name: A curtain on a pole
things.line: It hides the back of the room.
things.look: GM-ONLY-look: a person could stand behind it, and someone has.

things.name: A stool for the attendant
things.line: Low, with a cushion worn flat.
things.look: GM-ONLY-look: a thermos, and the lid is still hot.

things.name: A flickering lamp
things.line: A shade the colour of weak tea.
things.look: GM-ONLY-look: it flickers when the lift runs.

lines: Table four was meant to be quiet tonight.
I carry the tray; I don’t carry the talk.
If you want the good seats, ask me before they’re taken.
looks: Starched jacket gone grey at the cuffs.
Tray balanced on one flat palm.
waiter.pose: Weight on one foot, tray high
waiter.face: Smiles at the room, never at you

lines: I’ve seen worse on a Monday.
looks: Rubber boots and a bucket on one wrist.
Sleeves pushed up, hands red from the water.
cleaner.face: Eyes on the floor, ears on you
